verdict.rationale: Reflect's AI palette (cmd+j on highlighted text) accepts free-form natural-language requests that can be saved as custom prompts. Users can also 'chat' with filtered notes to ask questions, and semantic search works without exact keywords. However, this natural language covers text transformation and Q&A over notes, not operating the app itself: nothing shows NL commands creating, tagging, linking, publishing or navigating notes. missing for 10: natural-language control of app actions (create/organize/publish notes, run commands), an agentic assistant that executes multi-step operations, independent or hands-on corroboration of the AI features.
